info.name: Activity Management System (AMS) API
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman Collection for the Activity Management System (AMS) — AI-Assisted Insider Threat Behavioral Intelligence Platform.

Fulfills PDF Spec Page 14 ('Dev & Deployment Tools: Postman').

Covers all 11 operational modules:
01. Authentication & RBAC (Role profiles, JWT auto-capture, SSO fast-path)
02. Employee Directory & Baselines (Dossiers, 30-day benchmarks, forensic notes, Excel export)
03. Telemetry Stream (Telemetry summary, query logs, CSV export)
04. Behavioral Anomalies (Anomaly report, threshold criteria)
05. Incident Management & Triage (Consolidated queue, forensic investigation, showcase scenarios, triage PATCH)
06. Risk Scoring & Analytics (Fleet overview, deterministic 5-factor recalculation, weights, CSV export)
07. Executive Posture (KPIs, 4-tab workbook export)
08. Notifications & Diagnostics (Channel status, diagnostic alert, daily digest, health check)
09. Live Windows Event Ingestion (Status, identity mappings CRUD, quarantine log, test harness)
10. Machine Learning Operations (UEBA) (Isolation forest metadata, retraining, feature vectors)
11. Executive PDF Report (ReportLab PDF generation per Spec 204, export audit logging)

request.description: Returns aggregate telemetry metrics across severity tiers (Critical, High, Medium, Low, Info) and event categories.

item.name: Get Guided Attack Scenarios Showcase (Real DB Data)

request.description: Returns the 4 verified real guided attack scenarios pulled directly from database records (Marcus Hale, Chen Wei, Amara Diallo, Viktor Sorokin).
Retrieves consolidated incident evidence, triggering anomaly, and correlated ±2h and ±24h telemetry window.
Exports styled openpyxl Excel spreadsheet of active and resolved incidents.
Transitions incident lifecycle status and records investigator audit note.
Returns organizational risk KPIs, 7-day threat velocity points, risk distribution, and department score bands.
Executes the deterministic 5-factor weighted scoring formula (35% Anom / 25% Priv / 20% Data / 10% Sched / 10% Hist).
Retrieves the active 5-factor risk scoring weights and heuristic constraints.
Exports organizational department risk posture and breakdown to CSV.
High-level threat intelligence summary for executive leadership with fleet threat index and top high-risk users.
Exports 4-tab executive workbook (Summary, Risk Tier Roster, Department Posture, Incident Performance).
Administrator-only. Reports the real, unsimulated operational status of the Windows Event Log Listener service, host OS compatibility, and ingestion counts.

item.name: Get Employee ML Feature Vector & Corroboration Score

request.description: Fetches employee detail dossier including 5-dimensional ML feature vector (daily_event_volume, off_hours_ratio, data_transfer_volume_mb, privilege_change_count, anomaly_tag_count) and ml_corroboration_score.

item.name: Export Employee Dossier with ML Intelligence
